newsitem.title: USA: Source One Q4 loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: Source One Q4 loss vs profit.

text.p: Source One Mortgage Services Corp on Wednesday reported a fourth-quarter net loss of $31.8 million compared with net income of $4.2 million in the same period of 1995.
Revenues dropped to $20.4 million from $31.3 million. A company representative was not available to provide per-share or average share data.

The fourth-quarter 1996 results include a $25.9 million after-tax write-off of the company's goodwill and other intangible assets, an $18.5 million after-tax charge for impairment of its capitalized servicing asset and a $9.8 million after tax-gain on financial instruments.

The fourth quarter 1995 results include a $7.7 million after-tax gain on the sale of $1.1 billion of servicing rights, a $10.5 million after-tax charge for impairment of the company's capitalized servicing asset and a $600,000 after-tax gain on financial instruments.
For the year, the company had a net loss of $4.3 million on revenues of $148.7 million. For the 1995 period, Source One reported net income of $26.2 million on revenues of $148.6 million.
